normalization.name: PE64-CODE-V1
normalization.file: All raw bytes including non-code/certificate/overlay bytes participate in whole-file hashes. This is not the mapped image digest.
normalization.code: Immutable executable sections ordered by RVA. Digest prefix is GAME-CODE-V1 followed by NUL. Protected span is VirtualSize when nonzero, otherwise SizeOfRawData; section bounds validate max(span, rawSize). Copy min(rawSize, span), zero-fill the remainder. Writable sections are not normalized immutable code.
normalization.relocation: Only supported HIGHLOW/DIR64 entries with bounded, non-overlapping operands. Native verifies the expected loader adjustment before clearing relocation operand bytes. Unsupported/malformed relocation entries are rejected; normalized operands are zero.
normalization.imports: Mutable IAT is not conflated with whole immutable code assurance. Existing API readonly/target/module checks remain separate. Import directory content is not silently stripped from the whole-file hash.
normalization.pdata: Validate exception-directory range, bounded 12-byte runtime records, order/nonoverlap, executable function extent and aligned raw non-executable unwind location even without a checker anchor. Existing anchor-to-runtime-range coverage remains separate. This is not a complete Windows unwinder semantic proof.
normalization.exports: EAT/export coverage is a separate optional measurement with explicit status. FULL module-file/code coverage never implies every export was measured.
normalization.headers: SelfImageHeaders measures its bounded approved header ranges, not all mapped image memory.
normalization.compatibility: Previously accepted malformed PE may now be rejected. Publish server, BAT and native validators together; run the 28-case corpus with the compiled Delphi probe before release. No actual deployed files were tested here.

fileOwnership.synchronousPosition: IntegrityHashHandle and pinned readers use ReOpenFile plus explicit OVERLAPPED offsets, not SetFilePointer on the supplied/duplicate handle. Same original FILE_OBJECT stays pinned before name unlink/replacement.
fileOwnership.limits: Cancellation is cooperative. CancelIoEx is a request, not proof of completion. Detached operations own buffer/event/handle until completion. Resource-exhaustion drain and uninterruptible metadata calls can exceed deadline. No thread termination/free-before-completion.

measurementBundle.legacy: Missing new metadata is a legacy-compatible path, not evidence of the new coherent FULL plan.
measurementBundle.generationLimit: Before/after module-handle enumeration can miss unload/reload ABA. Client reports are not complete runtime attestation. FULL means mandatory scopes of this plan, not every optional EAT layer/all process memory.

pinRotationReview.current: Exact leaf certificate DER SHA-256; retain the 8-field v4 profile and manual TLS rotation/new trusted profile delivery. No arbitrary second pin, unknown-certificate acceptance or downgrade fallback.
futureDesign: A new versioned profile/envelope is required. Next pin must be delivered over the current pinned connection and authenticated with a purpose-separated server authority signature; changing pinned identity through unauthenticated discovery is forbidden.

Bind current pin, next pin, endpoint host/port/site, profile revision, policy epoch, activation, overlap end and expiry. At most two pins during a bounded overlap; overlap duration must be an explicit deployment policy, never an unbounded fallback.
Store/validate monotonic revision and enforce antirollback, cross-endpoint rejection, replay deduplication and bounded wall/monotonic expiry. A backward clock jump must not extend trust indefinitely.
Require recent administrator reauthentication and an approved release/key-rotation record to schedule a rotation; keep communication, release and CI key roles separate.

After overlap expiry reject the old pin. Failed refresh, restored old profile, missing current trust, concurrent versions or invalid signature must fail closed or require a newly authenticated launcher/profile, not autoaccept.
Before implementation test old/new transition, expiry during request, response loss, rollback, endpoint mix, revoked signing key, clock changes and client restarts on Windows. These are NOT_RUN here.
pinRotationReview.whyNotEnabled: Native current profile has one exact pin. Silent protocol expansion would break the existing approved A/B/O wire contract; the requirement requested review of a transition design, not unverified automatic acceptance.

networkAndWork.offloaded: RSA-OAEP unwrap, AES-GCM authenticated decrypt/strict JSON, PE hashes/normalization/capabilities. Private key passes as structured-cloned KeyObject; no second store writer.
networkAndWork.notOffloaded: Existing device signature checks inside single-writer authorization/receipt transactions remain synchronous. This is bounded admission/fairness improvement, not complete per-session CPU scheduling or DDoS protection.
networkAndWork.metrics: Connection count, auth latency, lane capacity/active/queued/rejected, identified verify+overlayVerify failure ratio. The last ratio excludes failures before a request is identified as renewal.

overlay.shutdown: Stop admission, signal cancellation, join worker safely, then reset after join and send Close only with remaining budget. WaitFor cannot safely guarantee a hard limit for unresponsive OS calls. Record overrun; never force terminate or free a running owner.
overlay.renewal: Use remaining lease, recent verification duration and a 30-second ceiling. A reply received after expiry never revives authorization.
overlay.graphics: Classify device removed/reset/hung, OOM and resize failures; no automatic device recreation, fail closed.
overlay.dpi: PerMonitorV2, suggested WM_DPICHANGED rectangle, common render/hit-test scale and focus/minimize/display input release. Actual Windows multi-monitor/RDP/GPU behavior unverified.

buildAndMitigations.sourceGuard: Release role-specific evaluated MSBuild property checks and fresh DCU directories; root DCU/CFG and foreign test/probe define/options/output rejected. Actual CodeGear execution unverified.
buildAndMitigations.cfg: Final PE structural evidence is distinct from compiler call-site coverage and actual runtime enforcement. Flag-only checks are insufficient. Record compiler files/version/hash and Windows query results separately.
buildAndMitigations.policies: Set success/error and actual GetProcessMitigationPolicy observations are separate. Preserve existing opt-in dynamic prohibit; no untested blanket strict-handle/image-loading/ACG enforcement.
